text:
incidents-bot: PAGER: P1 - routing: requests blackholed to dedicated-pool-12 (high error rate)
Alex P.: paging Ira and Samir, seeing a spike in 5xx from router -> dedicated pools. dashboard shows router success_rate drop to 60%
Ira (oncall): I'm on it, grabbing logs + routing map. Do we have a customer impact list?
Marta G.: @Ira (oncall) looks like customers on region-eu-west saw the hit. I can pull affected API keys now.
Samir R.: noticed autoscaler for pool-12 had scaled down aggressively ~8m ago. metrics look off: reported running_replicas=0 but infra shows 3 pods.
Alex P.: that mismatch smells like a metrics-aggregation bug between gpu-metrics-exporter and our autoscaler. could be the wrong label used in the query.
Ira (oncall): quick mitigation: can we force router to failover to pool-13 (same model variant) while we investigate?
Nora: I can flip routing policy to prefer pool-13 for the affected model. doing it now (rollbackable).
ops-bot: Deploy request: change routing preference for model-id redwood/gptx-8b -> pool-13 sent by Nora.
DeployBot: Automated check passed for small traffic reroute. Applying with canary 5%.
Marta G.: pulling customer impact: 12 API keys with >50% errors in last 10m, mostly eu-west retail customers.
Samir R.: looking at autoscaler queries, the config used `sum(gpu_allocated) by (pool)` instead of `sum(gpu_running_replicas)` — that's the wrong metric. I think the autoscaler responded to stale/aggregated allocation metrics and scaled down routes incorrectly.
Alex P.: that explains router routing decisions: router queries the control plane for healthy variants, control plane saw pool capacity low and rerouted to variant that didn't actually exist in that region (variant id mismatch).
Ira (oncall): mitigation status: reroute to pool-13 canary bumped to 50%. errors dropping to 10% in eu-west. continuing to 100% if stable.
Samir R.: I'm going to manually scale pool-12 back to desired replicas as emergency: `infractl pool scale pool-12 --replicas 6`
Nora: acked, but note pool-12 pods had `CrashLoopBackOff` reported in kube for one replica group - investigating container logs.
Marta G.: customers impacted: 3 paying customers have reported degraded latency and errors via support. Support notified them we're investigating and doing mitigations.
Alex P.: checking router logs: entries showing `no_available_variant` and `fallback_policy=swap_to_variant:staging-8b` repeatedly. Looks like fallback policy pointed to a variant id that was removed in a prior deploy. There was a misaligned mapping between model catalog and router policy.
Samir R.: timeline: 08:02 autoscaler query changed (PR #2431) -> 08:07 pool-12 scaled down -> 08:10 router started rerouting -> 08:12 spike in 5xx.
Ira (oncall): action list for now:
- (urgent) keep reroute to pool-13 until pool-12 healthy (Nora)
- (urgent) manual scale of pool-12 to 6 replicas (Samir)
- (high) revert autoscaler metric query to previous version / disable autoscale for affected pools (Alex)
- (high) update fallback routing policy to not reference deleted variants (Marta)
- (post) incident page with timeline and customer impact (Ira)
Nora: reroute at 100% applied. eu-west errors down to 3% after 90s.
Samir R.: pool-12 manual scale finished, pods coming up. possible image pull delays for one node, `ImagePullBackOff` seen on node eu-3. Investigating registry latency.
Alex P.: I'm preparing a temporary ACL to prevent control-plane from using `swap_to_variant:staging-8b` fallback until the catalog is fixed. patching now.
ops-bot: ACL change applied to control-plane-routing for model redwood/gptx-8b (temporary block on staging-8b).
Marta G.: updated fallback policy to point to `redwood/gptx-8b-v2` and queued a catalog sync.
Ira (oncall): customer impact update: errors affecting 0.9% of total tokens across platform, 12 customers impacted with 3 escalations. Support routing with priority replies.
Samir R.: registry latency resolved, pulled missing image on eu-3, pods healthy. replicas for pool-12 now 6 and ready.
Alex P.: control plane now reports correct running_replicas and router has stopped choosing the deleted variant. Looks stable in eu-west for 7m.
Ira (oncall): beginning handoff to Samir for overnight monitoring. Samir can you take the pager?
Samir R.: taking the pager. I'll keep reroute in place for 30m then gradually shift back to pool-12 once stable.
Ira (oncall): handoff notes:
- Root cause: autoscaler used the wrong metric (`gpu_allocated` vs `gpu_running_replicas`) after config change, caused underprovisioning -> router fallback to deleted variant -> blackholing.
- Mitigations enacted: forced reroute to pool-13, manual scale of pool-12, ACL block on staging fallback, fallback policy updated, catalog sync queued.
- Customer impact: 12 customers, 3 escalations, ~6 minutes of elevated errors for eu-west.
- Next steps: postmortem + PR to lock metric queries and add smoke test for fallback policies.
Ira (oncall): logging incident in pager duty with severity P1, will draft initial postmortem. Samir you're oncall owner for follow-up.
Samir R.: noted. I'll publish a short incident summary and create the follow-up tasks: fix autoscaler query (PR), add validation for fallback policies (integration test), improve canary for routing changes.
Marta G.: support will send final customer status update in 30m.
incidents-bot: Incident acknowledged by Ira (oncall).
Alex P.: adding low-level timeline to the incident doc and will include kube/event snippets and the autoscaler query diff.
Ira (oncall): thanks everyone — keep updates in this thread if anything changes. I'm un-paging now and leaving follow-ups to Samir. :thumbsup:
Samir R.: I'll post the postmortem link here when available.
Nora: nice quick coordination everyone.
ops-bot: Auto-reminder scheduled: postmortem draft due in 48h.
